classification.difficultyReason: Part u requires converting a reflex central angle to a minor angle, recognising equal radii to find base angles, and subtracting one from an angle obtained using the cyclic quadrilateral.

spec.description: Cyclic quadrilateral and both diagonals; all four angle sectors and the external 20-degree leader retained.
spec.mathematics: The lower-left angle in the triangle with 53 degrees and x is 50+20=70 degrees.

answer.worked:
At the upper-right vertex, the angle between the top side and diagonal is $50^\circ$ because it stands on the same arc as the given $50^\circ$ angle. Adding the given $20^\circ$ gives a full angle of $70^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}x+53^\circ+70^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=57^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Parallel left and right sides marked with double arrows; diagonal and 33-, 85-degree and x labels.
spec.mathematics: The upper-left interior angle is 95 degrees and the lower-left diagonal angle is 33 degrees.

answer.worked:
The upper-left interior angle is $180^\circ-85^\circ=95^\circ$ (opposite angles). The lower-left angle between the left side and diagonal is $33^\circ$ (alternate angles).
$$\begin{aligned}x+95^\circ+33^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=52^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Parallel upper and lower sides, diagonal from upper left to lower right and three angle labels.
spec.mathematics: The full upper-left interior angle is 106 degrees, split into x and 58 degrees.

answer.worked:
Co-interior angles on parallel lines are supplementary.
$$\begin{aligned}x+58^\circ+74^\circ&=180^\circ\\x&=48^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Four circle points with the top-to-lower-right chord extended; x at left and the exterior 150-degree angle at lower right.
spec.mathematics: The lower-right interior angle is 30 degrees and subtends the same arc as x.

answer.worked: The lower-right interior angle is $180^\circ-150^\circ=30^\circ$ (straight line). It and $x$ stand on the same arc, so $x=30^\circ$.

spec.description: Left and right chords, crossing diagonals, upward right-chord extension, 147-degree exterior angle and 100-degree right crossing sector.
spec.mathematics: Upper-right triangle angle is 33 degrees; lower-right angle is 47 degrees and stands on the same arc as x.

answer.worked:
The upper-right interior angle is $180^\circ-147^\circ=33^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}\theta&=180^\circ-100^\circ-33^\circ\\\theta&=47^\circ\end{aligned}$$
$x=47^\circ$ because angles on the same arc are equal.

spec.description: Upper side extended left with exterior 108 degrees; opposite interior angle x at lower right.
spec.mathematics: Exterior angle equals the opposite interior angle.

answer.worked: $x=108^\circ$ because an exterior angle of a cyclic quadrilateral equals the opposite interior angle.

spec.description: Two side chords and crossing diagonals with a at upper left, b in the left crossing sector and leaders to the 30- and 50-degree right-vertex angles.
spec.mathematics: a subtends the same arc as 30 degrees; b is vertically opposite the 100-degree angle of the right triangle.

answer.worked:
$a=30^\circ$ (angles on the same arc). The angle at the crossing in the right triangle is
$$\begin{aligned}\theta&=180^\circ-30^\circ-50^\circ\\\theta&=100^\circ\end{aligned}$$
$b=100^\circ$ (vertically opposite angles).

spec.description: Left, bottom and right side chords with crossing diagonals; 36 degrees at upper right, a at lower right, 54-degree leader at lower left and b in the left crossing sector.
spec.mathematics: a=54 by same-arc angles; the upper-left angle of the left triangle equals 36 degrees.

answer.worked:
$a=54^\circ$ (angles on the same arc). The upper-left angle in the left triangle is $36^\circ$ (angles on the same arc).
$$\begin{aligned}b+54^\circ+36^\circ&=180^\circ\\b&=90^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Cyclic quadrilateral with parallel upper and lower sides and all four interior angle labels.
spec.mathematics: a+75=180; b+75=180 by co-interior angles; b+c=180.

answer.worked:
Opposite angles are supplementary.
$$a=180^\circ-75^\circ=105^\circ$$
Co-interior angles on parallel lines are supplementary.
$$b=180^\circ-75^\circ=105^\circ$$
Opposite angles are supplementary.
$$c=180^\circ-105^\circ=75^\circ$$

spec.description: Inscribed quadrilateral with an unlabelled centre dot, two upper radii, a and 52 degrees splitting the upper-left angle, central b and 73 degrees at lower right.
spec.mathematics: a+52+73=180; two radii make the upper triangle isosceles.

answer.worked:
Opposite angles are supplementary.
$$\begin{aligned}a+52^\circ+73^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=55^\circ\end{aligned}$$
The two radii form an isosceles triangle.
$$\begin{aligned}b+55^\circ+55^\circ&=180^\circ\\b&=70^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Cyclic quadrilateral with upper-left to bottom diagonal, leaders to the 41-degree and b sectors, a at left and 62 degrees at right.
spec.mathematics: a is opposite 62 degrees; a, 41 and b are angles of the left triangle.

answer.worked:
Opposite angles are supplementary.
$$\begin{aligned}a+62^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=118^\circ\end{aligned}$$
Angles in the left triangle sum to $180^\circ$.
$$\begin{aligned}b+118^\circ+41^\circ&=180^\circ\\b&=21^\circ\end{aligned}$$

spec.description: Cyclic quadrilateral with an unlabelled centre, radii to the left vertices, a reflex 270-degree central arc on the right and every given/unknown label.
spec.mathematics: Minor central angle is 90 degrees; left radius triangle is isosceles; lower-left interior angle is 80 degrees.

answer.worked:
The minor central angle is $360^\circ-270^\circ=90^\circ$. The two radii form an isosceles triangle.
$$\begin{aligned}2a+90^\circ&=180^\circ\\a&=45^\circ\end{aligned}$$
The lower-left interior angle is $180^\circ-100^\circ=80^\circ$ (opposite angles). Its angle between the radius and left side is $45^\circ$.
$$b=80^\circ-45^\circ=35^\circ$$
